headers.name: Trace
headers.header: abbrev Trace

headers.name: Outcome
headers.header: abbrev Outcome (α : Type u)

headers.name: scanVolume
headers.header: def scanVolume (trace : Trace) : Nat

headers.name: scanVolume_nil
headers.header: @[simp] theorem scanVolume_nil : scanVolume [] = 0

headers.name: scanVolume_cons
headers.header:
@[simp] theorem scanVolume_cons (n i : Nat) (trace : Trace) :
    scanVolume ((n, i) :: trace) = n + scanVolume trace

headers.name: prepend
headers.header: def prepend (n i calls : Nat) (result : Outcome α) : Outcome α

headers.name: run
headers.header: def run : Nat → List α → PMF (Outcome α)

headers.name: run_nil
headers.header:
@[simp] theorem run_nil (k : Nat) :
    run k ([] : List α) = PMF.pure (none, ([], 2))

headers.name: run_cons
headers.header:
theorem run_cons (k : Nat) (head : α) (tail : List α) :
    run k (head :: tail) =
      PMF.bind (RandomQuickSort.uniformIndex tail.length) fun i =>
        let action := stepRun k (head :: tail) i
        match action.1 with
        | Sum.inl (j, ys) =>
            PMF.map (prepend (head :: tail).length i.val action.2) (run j ys)
        | Sum.inr p => PMF.pure (some p, ([((head :: tail).length, i.val)], action.2))

headers.name: run_value
headers.header:
theorem run_value (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) : result.1 = (ordered xs)[k]?

headers.name: run_ranked
headers.header:
theorem run_ranked (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) (a : α) (ha : result.1 = some a) :
    RankedAt xs k a

headers.name: run_none
headers.header:
theorem run_none (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) : result.1 = none ↔ xs.length ≤ k

headers.name: run_valid
headers.header:
theorem run_valid (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (hk : k < xs.length)
    (result : Outcome α) (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    ∃ a, result.1 = some a ∧ RankedAt xs k a

headers.name: run_support_bounds
headers.header:
private theorem run_support_bounds (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    result.2.1.length ≤ xs.length ∧
      xs.length ≤ scanVolume result.2.1 ∧
      2 * scanVolume result.2.1 ≤ xs.length * (xs.length + 1) ∧
      scanVolume result.2.1 ≤ result.2.2 ∧
      result.2.2 ≤ 9 * scanVolume result.2.1 + 2 ∧
      ∀ entry ∈ result.2.1, 0 < entry.1 ∧ entry.2 < entry.1 ∧ entry.1 ≤ xs.length

headers.name: run_active_calls_le
headers.header:
theorem run_active_calls_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) : result.2.1.length ≤ xs.length

headers.name: run_initial_scan_le
headers.header:
theorem run_initial_scan_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) : xs.length ≤ scanVolume result.2.1

headers.name: run_scanVolume_le
headers.header:
theorem run_scanVolume_le (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    scanVolume result.2.1 ≤ xs.length * (xs.length + 1) / 2

headers.name: run_source_bridge
headers.header:
theorem run_source_bridge (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    scanVolume result.2.1 ≤ result.2.2 ∧ result.2.2 ≤ 9 * scanVolume result.2.1 + 2

headers.name: run_trace_entries
headers.header:
theorem run_trace_entries (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    ∀ entry ∈ result.2.1, 0 < entry.1 ∧ entry.2 < entry.1 ∧ entry.1 ≤ xs.length

headers.name: run_source_quadratic
headers.header:
theorem run_source_quadratic (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (run k xs).support) :
    result.2.2 ≤ 9 * (xs.length * (xs.length + 1) / 2) + 2

headers.name: select
headers.header: def select (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : PMF (Outcome α)

headers.name: select_value
headers.header:
theorem select_value (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (select k xs).support) : result.1 = sortSelect k xs

headers.name: select_none
headers.header:
theorem select_none (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (select k xs).support) :
    result.1 = none ↔ k = 0 ∨ xs.length < k

headers.name: select_some_iff
headers.header:
theorem select_some_iff (k : Nat) (xs : List α) (result : Outcome α)
    (hr : result ∈ (select k xs).support) (a : α) :
    result.1 = some a ↔ 0 < k ∧ RankedAt xs (k - 1) a

headers.name: scanLaw
headers.header: def scanLaw (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : PMF Nat

headers.name: sourceLaw
headers.header: def sourceLaw (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : PMF Nat

headers.name: scanLaw_support
headers.header:
theorem scanLaw_support (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (scanLaw k xs).support ⊆ Set.Iic (xs.length * (xs.length + 1) / 2)

headers.name: scanLaw_support_finite
headers.header: theorem scanLaw_support_finite (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : (scanLaw k xs).support.Finite

headers.name: sourceLaw_support
headers.header:
theorem sourceLaw_support (k : Nat) (xs : List α) :
    (sourceLaw k xs).support ⊆ Set.Iic (9 * (xs.length * (xs.length + 1) / 2) + 2)

headers.name: sourceLaw_support_finite
headers.header: theorem sourceLaw_support_finite (k : Nat) (xs : List α) : (sourceLaw k xs).support.Finite

proof_corrections: After splitting the dependent match in run_cons, explicitly name its discriminant equation and simplify the ordinary match with the same equation.

Normalize the child decrease and local source-cost hypotheses by List.length_cons before arithmetic; express the equivalent triangular product majorant as tail.length * (tail.length + 1), eliminating the predecessor expression and its now-unnecessary helper equality.
Replace the unnecessary simpa in the terminal branch product inequality with direct simp, as requested by the actual diagnostic.

statement_assessment.quantifiers_types_hypotheses: All 30 headers, including the complete let-containing run_cons type and private support-bounds conjunction, are byte-identical. No premise, typeclass, rank domain or Option boundary changed.
statement_assessment.execution_semantics: Every definition body is byte-identical: fresh uniform current occurrence at each active call, stepRun executes the actual selected strict child, equal branch terminates, empty continuation remains explicit, traces and source calls come from that same execution.
statement_assessment.arithmetic: The new local hproduct is the same inequality because (head::tail).length = tail.length + 1 and this positive predecessor is tail.length. All six conjunctions and sharp constants remain unchanged.
statement_assessment.satisfiability_and_cases: All existing 20 public example claims and their bodies are unchanged, including valid/invalid/empty ranks, duplicates and the actual-shorter-than-larger-side example. No intended expectation was revised to obtain green.
statement_assessment.restrictions: No axioms, sorry/admit, linter suppression, declaration deletion, probability assumptions, larger-partition execution substitute, or source/API change.
